title: Tall whites' two-month trip to a star near Arcturus, so craft must exceed light speed

tellings.quote: And this was in the mid 1960s. This was like in 1965, the late summer. And there was a six-w weekek or two-month period

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he worked at Range Three near Indian Springs, Nevada, alongside tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites, says that in late summer 1965 some of them were gone for about six weeks to two months. He told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that, from what beings he calls the Teacher, Range Four Harry and the Tour Guide said, they had made a round trip to a star near Arcturus, a bright star in our sky, in that time. He reasons that their craft must go faster than light, since nothing slower could make that trip so quickly.
